title: Dubai Off-Plan Market 2026: Correction or Crash? Real Numbers + 2027 Forecast
description:
Dubai home sales fell 38% in Q3 2026, prices are about 10% below their February peak, and a record supply wave is still coming. Is the Dubai off-plan market heading for a correction or a crash?

In this episode of TheRealFlow podcast, Mario breaks down the Dubai off-plan market for developers, with real numbers and no hype:

• Why buyers became careful, not absent, after the war started in February
• Why almost 3 out of 4 homes sold in Dubai are still off-plan
• Apartments vs villas: where prices are falling most
• The 2027 supply wave: 60,000 or 160,000+ units?
• Discounting vs holding price: two opposite developer strategies
• What S&P Global, UBS and Emaar's founder expect
• Mario's forecast for the next 6 months and for 2027

This episode is for information only and is not financial advice.

title: The Verification Gap
description:
Your buyers can now compare your 2018 renderings with Google Street View in under a minute. Every developer has a gap between what they promised and what they built. The question is how big yours is.
In this episode, Mario Comando, co-founder of SuitesFlow, explains the verification gap: the distance between a developer’s renderings and the finished building. He walks through how smart off-plan buyers measure it, and why they’ll increasingly demand data instead of narrative.
You’ll learn:
The simple Street View exercise that reveals any developer’s track recordThe six pieces of data buyers should ask for before signingThe red flags that show a developer isn’t ready to commitWhy this scrutiny is inevitable, and how developers can turn it into an advantage
It sounds like an episode against developers. It isn’t. It’s the hard truth most marketers won’t say out loud: the developers who win the next cycle will hand buyers the proof before they ask for it, then sell an even bigger dream on top of it.

🎧 Follow TheRealFlow so you don’t miss the next episode.
